_note: Manifest of authoritative sources for regulatory rules in rules.json. Mirrors golden/policies/provenance.json discipline: one record per rule, with source URL, corroborating URLs, and retrieval metadata. Retrieved 2026-06-29. These are the first provenance-tracked regulatory-rule records in the corpus (see project_regulatory_grounding memory).

records.note: CMS is the primary authoritative source for Medicare COB rules. The eHealth article corroborates the primary-first adjudication principle and makes explicit that the primary plan's PA requirement must be satisfied before the secondary can process the claim.

Statutory basis: Social Security Act §1902(a)(25). The Medicaid.gov COB/TPL Handbook is the operational CMS guidance document for state Medicaid agencies on payer-of-last-resort enforcement. The quote is near-verbatim from standard CMS COB/TPL guidance language.

records.primary_source: NPR Health Shots — AKS copay coupon explainer (published 2018-05-09)
records.note: NPR article is the most accessible plain-language explanation of the Anti-Kickback Statute (42 U.S.C. §1320a-7b(b)) copay-card restriction for government-program enrollees. Covers both Medicare (including Medicare Advantage as a government product) and Medicaid as secondary payer. GoodRx article corroborates the commercial-only gate on copay card eligibility.
